WITH product_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    COUNT(*) as product_count
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY product_id
),
total_and_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    product_count,
    SUM(product_count) OVER () as total_count,
    product_count * 1.0 / SUM(product_count) OVER () as share
  FROM product_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM total_and_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    product_count,
    share,
    (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share) as avg_share
  FROM total_and_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(product_count) as combined_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess_share
FROM above_average
